nvse01.title: Who handles a late date better?
nvse01.caption:
Your date says they're running 10 minutes late. Do you pace or order a pastry?
Ten minutes is just pastry time.

nvse02.title: Who handles meeting the friends better?
nvse02.caption:
Meeting their friends for the first time? One sign learns every name, one brings cookies.
Curious beats perfect, every time.

nvse03.title: Who plans a first date better?
nvse03.caption:
Spotlight and a banner, or plan A, B and a laminated C?
The best first date has their favourite thing on it.

nvse04.title: Who handles a cancelled date better?
nvse04.caption:
They cancel because they're sick. How long do you stare at the reply box?
Keep it simple: rest up, I'll be here.

nvse05.title: Who buys a gift on a budget better?
nvse05.caption:
Tiny budget, big feelings. A day trip or a list of things they mentioned?
The best gifts prove you were listening.

nvse06.title: Who says “I like you” first better?
nvse06.caption:
Would you say it with a science-fair poster or a nine-page poem?
However it comes out, saying it is the brave part.

nvse07.title: Who handles an awkward pause better?
nvse07.caption:
The conversation goes quiet on a date. Staring contest or twenty questions?
A little quiet can be comfortable too.

nvse08.title: Who handles a party where they know nobody?
nvse08.caption:
Walking into a party where you know no one: snack table or take over the room?
You only need one friendly face to start.
